representation.name: Deconvolve target Visium spot
representation.description: Reference-signature NNLS with bootstrap and cross-validation diagnostics
representation.shell_command:
python - "$(inputs.archive.path)" <<'PY' > report.txt
import sys, tarfile, tempfile, os, itertools
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy.optimize import nnls

rng=np.random.RandomState(710)
p=sys.argv[1]
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="spatial_deconv_")
with tarfile.open(p,"r:*") as t: t.extractall(d)
files=[]
for root,dirs,names in os.walk(d):
    for n in names: files.append(os.path.join(root,n))
def pick(*parts):
    for f in files:
        b=os.path.basename(f)
        if all(x in b for x in parts): return f
    raise RuntimeError("missing "+str(parts))

sc=pd.read_csv(pick("sc_counts.csv"),index_col=0)
md=pd.read_csv(pick("sc_metadata.csv"))
md=md.rename(columns={md.columns[0]:"cell_id"})
md["cell_id"]=md["cell_id"].astype(str)
md=md.set_index("cell_id").loc[sc.index.astype(str)]
sp=mmread(pick("matrix.mtx")).tocsr()
features=pd.read_csv(pick("features.tsv"),sep="\t",header=None,compression="infer")
barcodes=pd.read_csv(pick("barcodes.tsv"),sep="\t",header=None,compression="infer").iloc[:,0].astype(str).tolist()
genes=features.iloc[:,1].astype(str).tolist()
assert list(sc.columns.astype(str))==genes
target="Spot_710-1"
j=barcodes.index(target)
y=np.asarray(sp[:,j].todense()).ravel().astype(float)
X=sc.values.astype(float)
types=sorted(md["cell_type"].astype(str).unique())
labels=md["cell_type"].astype(str).values
K=len(types)
G=len(genes)

# Mean raw signatures and mean cell-library-normalized signatures.
Rraw=np.column_stack([X[labels==t].mean(axis=0) for t in types])
libs=X.sum(axis=1)
Xn=X/np.maximum(libs[:,None],1)
Rnorm=np.column_stack([Xn[labels==t].mean(axis=0) for t in types])
yn=y/max(y.sum(),1)

def fit(A,b,idx=None):
    if idx is None: idx=np.arange(A.shape[0])
    w,res=nnls(A[idx,:],b[idx])
    prop=w/max(w.sum(),1e-30)
    pred=A.dot(w)
    rss=float(np.sum((b-pred)**2))
    return w,prop,rss

wraw,praw,rssraw=fit(Rraw,y)
wnorm,pnorm,rssnorm=fit(Rnorm,yn)

# Marker genes: strongest type-vs-rest log fold changes.
marker=set()
marker_by_type={}
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    other=np.delete(Rraw,k,axis=1).mean(axis=1)
    score=np.log2((Rraw[:,k]+0.1)/(other+0.1))
    ids=np.argsort(score)[-50:]
    marker.update(ids.tolist())
    marker_by_type[t]=ids
marker=np.array(sorted(marker))
wm,pm,rssm=fit(Rraw,y,marker)

# Highly discriminative genes by between-type variance after row normalization.
row_scale=Rraw.mean(axis=1)+0.1
disc=np.var(Rraw/row_scale[:,None],axis=1)
disc_ids=np.argsort(disc)[-300:]
wd,pd,rssd=fit(Rraw,y,disc_ids)

# Bootstrap genes and reference cells independently.
B=300
boot=np.zeros((B,K))
for b in range(B):
    gids=rng.choice(G,size=int(0.75*G),replace=False)
    cols=[]
    for t in types:
        ids=np.where(labels==t)[0]
        samp=rng.choice(ids,size=len(ids),replace=True)
        cols.append(X[samp].mean(axis=0))
    Rb=np.column_stack(cols)
    wb,_,_=fit(Rb,y,gids)
    boot[b]=wb/max(wb.sum(),1e-30)

# Leave-one-type-out relative deterioration.
loo={}
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    keep=[q for q in range(K) if q!=k]
    ww,_=nnls(Rraw[:,keep],y)
    pred=Rraw[:,keep].dot(ww)
    loo[t]=(np.sum((y-pred)**2)-rssraw)/max(rssraw,1e-30)

# Held-out-gene CV over all nonempty subsets, scored by normalized holdout MSE.
subsets=[]
for size in range(1,K+1):
    for comb in itertools.combinations(range(K),size):
        subsets.append(comb)
cv_scores={s:[] for s in subsets}
for repi in range(120):
    perm=rng.permutation(G)
    train=perm[:int(0.7*G)]
    test=perm[int(0.7*G):]
    denom=np.sum(y[test]**2)+1e-30
    for s in subsets:
        ww,_=nnls(Rraw[train][:,s],y[train])
        pred=Rraw[test][:,s].dot(ww)
        cv_scores[s].append(float(np.sum((y[test]-pred)**2)/denom))
cv_summary=[]
for s,vals in cv_scores.items():
    cv_summary.append((np.mean(vals),np.std(vals,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(vals)),s))
cv_summary.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
best_mean,best_se,best_s=cv_summary[0]
eligible=[z for z in cv_summary if z[0] <= best_mean+best_se]
one_se=min(eligible,key=lambda z:(len(z[2]),z[0]))

# Marker evidence: fraction of target UMIs in each type's top markers, compared with other signatures.
marker_evidence={}
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    ids=marker_by_type[t]
    observed=(y[ids].sum()+1)/(y.sum()+len(ids))
    expected=(Rraw[ids,k].sum()+1)/(Rraw[:,k].sum()+len(ids))
    other=(np.delete(Rraw,k,axis=1)[ids,:].mean(axis=1).sum()+1)/(np.delete(Rraw,k,axis=1).mean(axis=1).sum()+len(ids))
    marker_evidence[t]=(observed,expected,other,observed/max(other,1e-30))

# Context: fit every spot, report target rank and coefficient quantiles for threshold assessment.
all_prop=np.zeros((len(barcodes),K))
for jj in range(len(barcodes)):
    yy=np.asarray(sp[:,jj].todense()).ravel().astype(float)
    ww,_=nnls(Rraw,yy)
    all_prop[jj]=ww/max(ww.sum(),1e-30)

print("TARGET",target,"index",j,"UMIS",int(y.sum()),"NONZERO_GENES",int((y>0).sum()))
print("REFERENCE_CELL_COUNTS",dict((t,int(np.sum(labels==t))) for t in types))
print("RAW_NNLS")
for t,w,q in zip(types,wraw,praw): print(t,"weight",round(float(w),6),"proportion",round(float(q),6))
print("NORMALIZED_NNLS")
for t,w,q in zip(types,wnorm,pnorm): print(t,"weight",round(float(w),6),"proportion",round(float(q),6))
print("MARKER_NNLS",len(marker),"genes")
for t,w,q in zip(types,wm,pm): print(t,"weight",round(float(w),6),"proportion",round(float(q),6))
print("DISCRIMINATIVE_NNLS",len(disc_ids),"genes")
for t,w,q in zip(types,wd,pd): print(t,"weight",round(float(w),6),"proportion",round(float(q),6))
print("BOOTSTRAP")
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    q=np.quantile(boot[:,k],[0.025,0.5,0.975])
    print(t,"mean",round(float(boot[:,k].mean()),6),"CI95",*[round(float(x),6) for x in q],
          "P_gt_0.02",round(float(np.mean(boot[:,k]>0.02)),4),
          "P_gt_0.05",round(float(np.mean(boot[:,k]>0.05)),4))
print("LEAVE_ONE_OUT_RSS_INCREASE_FOLD")
for t in types: print(t,round(float(loo[t]),6))
print("CV_TOP10")
for mean,se,s in cv_summary[:10]:
    print(",".join(types[k] for k in s),"n",len(s),"mean",round(float(mean),8),"se",round(float(se),8))
print("CV_BEST",",".join(types[k] for k in best_s))
print("CV_ONE_SE",",".join(types[k] for k in one_se[2]),"mean",round(float(one_se[0]),8))
print("MARKER_EVIDENCE observed expected own expected other fold_vs_other")
for t in types: print(t,*[round(float(x),6) for x in marker_evidence[t]])
print("ALL_SPOT_PROP_QUANTILES_AND_TARGET")
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    qs=np.quantile(all_prop[:,k],[0,0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9,1])
    print(t,"quantiles",*[round(float(x),6) for x in qs],"target",round(float(praw[k]),6))
# Conservative consensus call: >=5% in every fit, bootstrap lower 95% >2%, and positive LOO evidence.
fits=np.vstack([praw,pnorm,pm,pd])
called=[]
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    if fits[:,k].min()>=0.05 and np.quantile(boot[:,k],0.025)>0.02 and loo[t]>0.01:
        called.append(t)
print("CONSENSUS_CALL",",".join(sorted(called)))
PY

    score=np.log2((Rraw[:,k]+0.1)/(other+0.1))
    ids=np.argsort(score)[-50:]
    marker.update(ids.tolist())
    marker_by_type[t]=ids
marker=np.array(sorted(marker))
wm,pm,rssm=fit(Rraw,y,marker)

# Highly discriminative genes by between-type variance after row normalization.
row_scale=Rraw.mean(axis=1)+0.1
disc=np.var(Rraw/row_scale[:,None],axis=1)
disc_ids=np.argsort(disc)[-300:]
wd,pd,rssd=fit(Rraw,y,disc_ids)

# Bootstrap genes and reference cells independently.
B=300
boot=np.zeros((B,K))
for b in range(B):
    gids=rng.choice(G,size=int(0.75*G),replace=False)
    cols=[]
    for t in types:
        ids=np.where(labels==t)[0]
        samp=rng.choice(ids,size=len(ids),replace=True)
        cols.append(X[samp].mean(axis=0))
    Rb=np.column_stack(cols)
    wb,_,_=fit(Rb,y,gids)
    boot[b]=wb/max(wb.sum(),1e-30)

# Leave-one-type-out relative deterioration.
loo={}
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    keep=[q for q in range(K) if q!=k]
    ww,_=nnls(Rraw[:,keep],y)
    pred=Rraw[:,keep].dot(ww)
    loo[t]=(np.sum((y-pred)**2)-rssraw)/max(rssraw,1e-30)

# Held-out-gene CV over all nonempty subsets, scored by normalized holdout MSE.
subsets=[]
for size in range(1,K+1):
    for comb in itertools.combinations(range(K),size):
        subsets.append(comb)
cv_scores={s:[] for s in subsets}
for repi in range(120):
    perm=rng.permutation(G)
    train=perm[:int(0.7*G)]
    test=perm[int(0.7*G):]
    denom=np.sum(y[test]**2)+1e-30
    for s in subsets:
        ww,_=nnls(Rraw[train][:,s],y[train])
        pred=Rraw[test][:,s].dot(ww)
        cv_scores[s].append(float(np.sum((y[test]-pred)**2)/denom))
cv_summary=[]
for s,vals in cv_scores.items():
    cv_summary.append((np.mean(vals),np.std(vals,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(vals)),s))
cv_summary.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
best_mean,best_se,best_s=cv_summary[0]
eligible=[z for z in cv_summary if z[0] <= best_mean+best_se]
one_se=min(eligible,key=lambda z:(len(z[2]),z[0]))

# Marker evidence: fraction of target UMIs in each type's top markers, compared with other signatures.
marker_evidence={}
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    ids=marker_by_type[t]
    observed=(y[ids].sum()+1)/(y.sum()+len(ids))
    expected=(Rraw[ids,k].sum()+1)/(Rraw[:,k].sum()+len(ids))
    other=(np.delete(Rraw,k,axis=1)[ids,:].mean(axis=1).sum()+1)/(np.delete(Rraw,k,axis=1).mean(axis=1).sum()+len(ids))
    marker_evidence[t]=(observed,expected,other,observed/max(other,1e-30))

# Context: fit every spot, report target rank and coefficient quantiles for threshold assessment.
all_prop=np.zeros((len(barcodes),K))
for jj in range(len(barcodes)):
    yy=np.asarray(sp[:,jj].todense()).ravel().astype(float)
    ww,_=nnls(Rraw,yy)
    all_prop[jj]=ww/max(ww.sum(),1e-30)

print("TARGET",target,"index",j,"UMIS",int(y.sum()),"NONZERO_GENES",int((y>0).sum()))
print("REFERENCE_CELL_COUNTS",dict((t,int(np.sum(labels==t))) for t in types))
print("RAW_NNLS")
for t,w,q in zip(types,wraw,praw): print(t,"weight",round(float(w),6),"proportion",round(float(q),6))
print("NORMALIZED_NNLS")
for t,w,q in zip(types,wnorm,pnorm): print(t,"weight",round(float(w),6),"proportion",round(float(q),6))
print("MARKER_NNLS",len(marker),"genes")
for t,w,q in zip(types,wm,pm): print(t,"weight",round(float(w),6),"proportion",round(float(q),6))
print("DISCRIMINATIVE_NNLS",len(disc_ids),"genes")
for t,w,q in zip(types,wd,pd): print(t,"weight",round(float(w),6),"proportion",round(float(q),6))
print("BOOTSTRAP")
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    q=np.quantile(boot[:,k],[0.025,0.5,0.975])
    print(t,"mean",round(float(boot[:,k].mean()),6),"CI95",*[round(float(x),6) for x in q],
          "P_gt_0.02",round(float(np.mean(boot[:,k]>0.02)),4),
          "P_gt_0.05",round(float(np.mean(boot[:,k]>0.05)),4))
print("LEAVE_ONE_OUT_RSS_INCREASE_FOLD")
for t in types: print(t,round(float(loo[t]),6))
print("CV_TOP10")
for mean,se,s in cv_summary[:10]:
    print(",".join(types[k] for k in s),"n",len(s),"mean",round(float(mean),8),"se",round(float(se),8))
print("CV_BEST",",".join(types[k] for k in best_s))
print("CV_ONE_SE",",".join(types[k] for k in one_se[2]),"mean",round(float(one_se[0]),8))
print("MARKER_EVIDENCE observed expected own expected other fold_vs_other")
for t in types: print(t,*[round(float(x),6) for x in marker_evidence[t]])
print("ALL_SPOT_PROP_QUANTILES_AND_TARGET")
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    qs=np.quantile(all_prop[:,k],[0,0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9,1])
    print(t,"quantiles",*[round(float(x),6) for x in qs],"target",round(float(praw[k]),6))
# Conservative consensus call: >=5% in every fit, bootstrap lower 95% >2%, and positive LOO evidence.
fits=np.vstack([praw,pnorm,pm,pd])
called=[]
for k,t in enumerate(types):
    if fits[:,k].min()>=0.05 and np.quantile(boot[:,k],0.025)>0.02 and loo[t]>0.01:
        called.append(t)
print("CONSENSUS_CALL",",".join(sorted(called)))
